machine: cloud container, 4 CPU, no GPU; torch CPU, 2 threads
choice: 18 features (16 + the two context features). The variant with the SaaS pairs is trained once the SaaS pairs are regenerated; until then the SaaS held-out row covers the SaaS clips done at training time.
why_18: The 16-feature matcher split a lone fast mover (seed-61 end-to-end test, 83 px in one frame, P 0.088): in the training data a far identical shape is almost always another copy (Lottie: 4 of 3366 same), which a pair alone cannot tell apart. With the context features the same pair scores P 0.80.
rho_curve: ECC-label agreement with truth is flat from rho 0.05 to 0.65 (0.9035; 0.8551 at 0): the mask-coverage condition decides, not the correlation, which is either high or 0 (ECC non-convergence).

shipped.sources: synthetic kinds (seeds 2-7 train, 8-9 held), LottieFiles free animations (Lottie Simple License), gold mk571 (Mixkit free)

superseded_16_features.choice: Ship the variant without the SaaS pairs: it has the better held-out AUC on both truth-labelled sources (synthetic seeds 8-9: 0.9952 vs 0.9908; held-out Lottie: 0.9916 vs 0.9878). The variant with SaaS scores higher only against the SaaS video-derived labels (0.977 vs 0.909), which agree with truth at 0.9035 but with precision 0.636 and recall 0.726 for 'same' on the training synthetic and Lottie clips: noisy labels.
